name: mcp-use
summary: Full-stack MCP framework (TypeScript and Python) for building MCP servers and MCP Apps with typed tools, React views, a built-in Inspector and agent clients.
description: Scaffold with `npx -y create-mcp-use-app@latest`, run `npm run dev` and open the Inspector at `http://localhost:3000/mcp/inspector`. Zod schemas flow from tool definitions to structured results; tools can bind React "Views" for MCP Apps (ChatGPT apps, Claude connectors). Also has an agent-friendly start prompt at `https://mcp-use.com/prompt.md`, a hosted Inspector, and a Python package for servers, clients and agents. npm `mcp-use` 2.11.2 (2.12 canaries in progress); PyPI `mcp-use` 1.7.1. Made by Manufact, which offers optional hosted deployment.
